limitations: Positive layer temperature difference describes observed temperature structure, not a complete stability diagnosis.
Thresholds are descriptive sensitivity checks, not instrument uncertainty estimates.
Run duration counts contiguous qualifying ten-minute records, not resolved continuous inversion duration.
Repeated visibility values at 20000 m are a diagnostic, not proof of censoring.
No imputation, no physical-model fitting, no wind estimation or simulation integration.
One site and observation period; no generalization claim.
